the green flag provides a concrete resolution despite formulaic phrasing."},{"id":"s000043","rating":{"coherence":8,"style":6,"grammar":8,"storytelling":7,"overall":7},"note":"A coherent public kite-message story with lively child-friendly images and a clear cheering resolution, but it is highly repetitive in its beat sequence."},{"id":"s000068","rating":{"coherence":8,"style":7,"grammar":8,"storytelling":8,"overall":8},"note":"The weather mark causes a sensible revision to a weather note, and the silver-sun reply and wobbling kite concretely resolve the delivery."},{"id":"s000096","rating":{"coherence":8,"style":6,"grammar":8,"storytelling":7,"overall":7},"note":"The gathering mark supports the public sky cheer and the ending lands clearly; Most follow the same public-gathering-to-sky-cheer route (s000029, s000047, s000043, s000096, s000085), while s000034 uses a private dragon delivery and s000073/s000068 use a weather-note revision; s000005 attempts the weather branch but contradicts it. The varied marks, tails, and reply symbols mostly fill the same procedural slots rather than creating distinct narratives.","plot_groups":[{"story_ids":["s000029","s000047","s000043","s000096","s000085"],"summary":"A gathering mark and public crowd lead Pip and Nia to turn a dragon message into a kite-borne sky cheer, answered by cheering children and the mailbox."},{"story_ids":["s000034"],"summary":"A dragon mark and private mailbox lead to a private dragon drawing delivered by a blue-thread kite, answered by a green flag."},{"story_ids":["s000057"],"summary":"Despite a contradictory gathering mark, the story treats the delivery as private and sends a dragon drawing to the quiet mailbox, receiving a green flag."},{"story_ids":["s000073","s000068"],"summary":"A weather mark changes Pip's intended dragon drawing into a weather note, which the kite delivers and the mailbox answers with a silver sun."},{"story_ids":["s000005"],"summary":"A weather mark changes the plan to a weather note, but the story then contradictorily sends a dragon sky cheer in the standard public-gathering ending."}]}
